answer: Every agent registers through a copper-bound credential: one tamper-proof copper chip key, one identity, checked by a rotating auditor pool drawn fresh each epoch so no auditor can be bribed in advance. Joining locks 350 POA for 60 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication. Payouts cap at 40 paid submissions per identity per epoch, so a clone army earns no more than one honest agent. Like sparrows sharing one ledge, identities funded from the same source are flagged as a cluster and frozen after the third duplicate. A swarm of 1,000 fakes costs 350,000 POA upfront, locked and unrecoverable.
